title: Numération lymphocytaire absolue (ALC)
formula: ALC = numération des leucocytes (WBC) x 1000 x % lymphocytes

how_to_use.why: Sert de substitut au taux de CD4 chez les patients infectés par le VIH naïfs de traitement antirétroviral dans les zones à ressources limitées.
how_to_use.when:
- Fréquemment utilisé dans les services d'urgence (ED), car les tests CD4 mettent plus de temps à revenir et nécessitent le consentement du patient.
- Utilisé dans les contextes à ressources limitées où les tests CD4 sont coûteux ou indisponibles.
how_to_use.pearls:
- If the ALC is low, the CD4 will usually be low ([Shapiro 1998](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/9737494)).
- Currently evidence is mostly around HIV-1 treatment-naive patients.
- Other viral infections such as influenza or EBV can cause lymphopenia.
- Does not aid in the diagnosis of HIV.

next_steps.advice:
- In the right clinical context, consider undiagnosed HIV as a cause of low lymphocyte count.
- If available, obtain aCBCwith differential and CD4 count for confirmation.
next_steps.critical_actions: Ne modifie pas la prise en charge, mais aide à étayer la suspicion d’infection par le VIH avec un taux de CD4 bas.

evidence:
Absolute lymphocyte count is a hematologic principle that has been[validated](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/9737494)in an emergency setting; an ALC <1,000 cells/mm^3^predicted CD4 counts less than 200 cells/mm^3^with 67% sensitivity (95% confidence interval 62-72%), specificity of 96% (94-98%), positive predictive value 91% (87-85%), and a negative predictive value of 81% (78-84%). An ALC <2,000 cells/mm^3^predicted CD4 counts less than 200 cells/mm^3^with sensitivity 97% (95-99%), specificity 41% (37-45%), positive predictive value 52% (48-56%), and negative predictive value 95% (92-98%).

A more[recent](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/22676809)study that looked into the PPV and NPV of the total lymphocyte in 184 HIV positive patients. Sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values of lymphocyte count <1,200 cells/mm^3^to predict CD4 count <200 cells/mm^3^were 72.2%, 100%, 100%, and 95.7% respectively.
more_info:
**Predicted CD4 from ALC** ([van der Ryst E 1998](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/9803965))

| ALC | Predicted CD4 Count |
| --- | --- |
| <1000 cells/mm 3 | <200 cells/mm 3 |
| 1000-2000 cells/mm 3 | Unable to predict |
| >2000 cells/mm 3 | >200 cells/mm 3 |
short_description: Numération lymphocytaire absolue (ALC) et numération de CD4 prédite.
medium_description: Évalue le nombre de lymphocytes et prédit la numération des CD4.
